book: Carleton's Consensus ecclesiae catholicae contra Tridentinos (1613), a Latin polemic with dedicatory and prefatory front matter, a prooemium, and four controversies (De Scripturis, De Ecclesia, De fide iustificante, De gratia), each divided into numbered chapters.
